answer: Each identity maintains a non-transferable relic chain of sequential unique proofs bound to its private key, decaying unless refreshed by original work each epoch. Verification follows a falcon-like single-use path that cannot be precomputed or amortized across a fleet. To harbor any weight, an attacker must pay linear time-and-compute cost per fake head, since the relic cannot be transferred or recycled and every identity restarts the chain independently.
